strongest_angle: Financial columnist Michelle Singletary detailed in October 2026 how growing consumer debt payments consume a massive portion of worker pay raises.

key_facts.fact: Washington Post personal finance columnist Michelle Singletary published an analysis on October 10, 2026, examining why pay raises leave workers feeling broke.
CNBC journalist Sharon Epperson reported on October 16, 2026, on research showing debt payments are eating up more of consumer income gains.
Kamaron McNair reported for CNBC on October 16, 2026, about Michelle Singletary and her work hosting the Dollars & Sense podcast.

quotes.text: Longtime money columnist on the advice everyone needs to hear: 'If debt was a person I would slap it'
